verification.scope: Local hash, schema, literal privacy, owner, URL, revision, and duplicate checks only.

limitations: Structural/documentation audit; repository code and model inference were not executed.
Workflow status comes from latest 100 default-branch runs, grouped by workflow; absent workflows remain unverified.
Card claims and listed artifact files are observations, not independent model evaluation or cryptographic verification.
File count and evidence-file absence are unknown when files_coverage is UNKNOWN; dataset files are fetched from exact-revision metadata.
Private inventory is outside this public snapshot; only records with literal private=false owned by szl-holdings or SZLHOLDINGS are included.
Classic branch protection and ruleset metadata were read; rule applicability, org security alerts, buckets and live endpoint responses remain unverified.
DECLARED source metadata is not deployment, runtime, evaluation, proof, or authorization evidence.
